$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNS (AIP France, chart dated 2024-10-03): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Sisteron-Thèze

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: Aerodrome reserved for home-based ACFT, gliding and service airplanes.
Available for helicopters under the conditions specified by DSAC-SE.
ACFT: from 01/03 to 30/09, avoid departures and arrivals late in the morning, in the beginning and at the end of the afternoon, during heavy gliding activity.
It is recommended to read "Special instructions LFNS" published on website: www.aerodrome-sisteron.com Priority at landing for gliders.
At TKOF and LDG, respect the road restriction 15 ft ASFC when overflying the secondary road located upstream THR 35.
Gliders paved strip 700 x 10 m reserved for gliders activity and for based ACFT out of gliders activity.
ZA31 parcel is located outside of movement area.
Taxiing of ACFT with running engine is prohibited.
Aerobatics on AD (NR 6911): 2450 ft AMSL - FL 065.
